description: Returns recently updated project items for the current user.

id.description: Position of this item in the recent-activity list.

details.description: Display label for the activity item.

number.description: Number of the underlying item, when applicable.

created_by.description: Name of the user who created the item.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the item was created.

updated_at.description: Timestamp when the item was last updated.

type.description: Human-readable type label for the item.

activity_type.description: Underscored class name of the underlying record.

url.description: URL to open the item in the project.

due_date.description: Due date of the item, when applicable.
